QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Urgent Message
QuestInfo.1: #bGen#k wants to meet up in Savage Terminal #bBlack Market#k.
QuestInfo.2: That meetup with Gen in Savage Terminal Black Market was pretty interesting.

0.msg: #b(Gen's been trying to get a hold of you. Better get that before you miss him.)#k\r\n

1.msg: Nice to finally hear from you again, Rookie. I've got some news that needs to be delivered in person.\r\n

2.msg: Come to Savage Terminal #bBlack Market#k, and I'll fill you in on the details. Now's good, right?

0.msg: Good. I'll meet you in the usual place. See you in a bit.\r\n#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k

no.0: #b(Oh, right, the radio's off. You should probably get that.)#k

0.msg: This is your chance to settle your grudge with Magnus once and for all.

2.msg: It's true. Heliseum Reclamation HQ is in a tough spot, but there are always warriors ready and waiting for a cause.\r\n

3.msg: Kaiser the Guardian, Angelic Buster, and some other foreign warriors are already providing support. We'll win.\r\n

4.msg: It's just a matter of time before we get Magnus. If you join as well...\r\n

5.msg: Well, of course, it's up to you. Let me know what you decide, and I'll give you what you need.\r\n

0.msg: #b(A chance to finally confront Magnus... Joining up with Heliseum Reclamation HQ is no question now.)#k\r\n
I'll wait for you in the usual place.\r\n
